items.followUp: What is a web browser? Name one web browser.

rubric.why: Identifies that a browser lets users reach web pages on the Internet.
rubric.description: States that a browser is used to access, retrieve, or open web pages.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating a correct purpose of accessing web pages.

rubric.why: Identifies that a browser presents web content for users.
rubric.description: States that a browser displays web pages so users can view or interact with them.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a browser displays web pages for users.

modelAnswer: A web browser is used to access and retrieve web pages from the Internet.
It displays the pages so that users can view and interact with them.
